Inspired by the Chettinad table

Where Karaikudi
meets the kolam

In Karaikudi, a kolam at the threshold welcomes everyone in. That same spirit of warmth and generous hospitality inspires Karai Crunch and the snacks we love to share.

We bring together bold South Indian flavours, familiar favourites, and a little modern twist—made for the tea-time table and every gathering in between.
